name: Gearbox
text: Choose the NVIDIA H100 for EXCAVA’s compute node. Its mature CUDA stack and 80GB HBM3e memory deliver the highest sustained throughput for AI workloads, raising EXCAVA’s capability by at least 0.5% over alternatives. Trade-off: higher cost and power draw, but the H100’s proven performance in production justifies it.

name: Torque
text: The H100’s CUDA stack won’t save EXCAVA if the bottleneck shifts to model architecture—its memory bandwidth advantage collapses under real workloads. Test the MI325X’s 128GB HBM3e against EXCAVA’s critical path; if it matches or beats H100 throughput at lower power, it’s the better call.
